opportunities.name: arXiv topic search → Semantic Scholar citation lookup → save note
opportunities.description: For a given research topic, year and arXiv subject: run an arXiv advanced title search, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar for the first author and citation count, then save a formatted note '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <first author>, <N> citations'.
steps: On arxiv.org click Search, then Advanced search
Clear the Search term field and type the topic; keep field = Title
Tick the subject checkbox (e.g. Computer Science or Quantitative Biology)
Select the 'Specific year' radio and type the year
Click Search
Open the first result (arXiv ID link) and copy its title
On semanticscholar.org paste the title into the search box and press Enter
Open the matching result; read the first author and citation count
In the Notes app click 'New note', type '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <first author>, <citations> citations' and press Enter

instances.values: topic='retrieval augmented generation', year=2023, subject=Computer Science → RIGHT: Retrieval-augmented Generation for Mainstream Hashtag Recommendation, Run-Ze Fan, 11 citations
topic='protein structure diffusion', year=2024, subject=Quantitative Biology → Accelerating Inference in Molecular Diffusion Models..., Ian Dunn, 7 citations
topic='graph neural networks traffic forecasting', year=2022, subject=Computer Science → Efficient Traffic State Forecasting..., Bin Lei, 1 citations

opportunities.name: Case law lookup on CourtListener + related statute on Cornell LII → save note
opportunities.description: For a given case name and related U.S.C. citation: find the case on CourtListener for its reporter citation and decision date, look up the statute on Cornell LII for its section title, then save the note '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<section title>)'.
steps: On CourtListener open Case Law > Search Case Law
Type the case name in 'Keyword(s) search with operators' and press Enter
Open the matching opinion (the Supreme Court decision); read its U.S. Reports citation and decision date
On law.cornell.edu (LII) type the U.S.C. citation in the search box and press Enter
Open the matching U.S. Code section result; read the section title
In the Notes app click 'New note', type '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<section title>)' and press Enter

instances.values: case='Carpenter v. United States' (585 U.S. 296, June 22, 2018); statute='18 U.S.C. 2703' (Required disclosure of customer communications or records)
case='Bostock v. Clayton County' (590 U.S. 644, June 15, 2020); statute='42 U.S.C. 2000e-2' (Unlawful employment practices)
case='Miranda v. Arizona' (384 U.S. 436, June 13, 1966); statute='18 U.S.C. 3501' (Admissibility of confessions)

opportunities.name: Peerspace venue search by activity and city
opportunities.description: Search Peerspace for venues by entering an activity and a city, picking the city from the autocomplete list, and clicking Search.
steps: Click the 'Enter your activity' combobox, select all (Ctrl+A) and type the activity
Click the 'Enter a city, zip, or address' combobox, select all (Ctrl+A) and type the city
Pick the matching city option from the Google autocomplete dropdown
Click Search (retry if the site says 'We don't recognize that activity')

instances.values: activity='Team offsite', city='Chicago, IL, USA' (several retries; leftover text 'Lille, HDF, FR' had to be cleared from the city field)
activity='Birthday party', city='San Francisco, CA, USA'

opportunities.name: 1800flowers product search
opportunities.description: Search 1-800-Flowers for a flower type and look through or open the results.
steps: Dismiss the cookie banner if it appears (Decline)
Click the Search combobox and select all (Ctrl+A)
Type the flower query and press Enter
Open the chosen product from the results and note its price

instances.values: query='white orchids' → opened White Phalaenopsis Orchid ($59.99)
